sentences.en: It will be late autumn when you get to London.
sentences.zh: 1. 当你到达伦敦的时候已经是深秋了。

sentences.en: There's nothing better than reading in the long autumn nights.
sentences.zh: 2. 没有什么比在漫长的秋天夜晚读书更好的事情了。

sentences.en: There are also people who like spring better than autumn.
sentences.zh: 3. 还有一些人更喜欢春天而不是秋天。

senses.zh: 秋天；成熟期；渐衰期，凋落期 -
秋天的，秋季的 形容词: autumnal
